notes.title: UPDATE #29: Fly High To The Sky! 🐉✨
notes.content:
[b]Good Day, Tips Fedora[/b]
Our goal for Ragna, Tru, and their Mech is to make them as exciting to use for exploring the world of Driftland as our small team can manage. This time, Ragna received the upgrades!

Instead of endlessly holding Shift to sprint, tapping it now makes Ragna flap her wings with powerful force, launching her forward in a temporary speed boost. Time it right and you can pull off two quick boosts – BUT with Dragon Boost Plus, you can chain three in a row!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/3107223bd94d6a6d62c1c6100e63ce96095b161a.gif[/img]

Additionally, Ragna can gain a boost by diving. The longer she dives, the longer the speed boost lasts. Combine this with a regular boost to create long, high-speed bursts!

We hope these changes will enhance Ragna’s scouting abilities and make traveling more fun and cool! ːsteamhappyː

We've also added some long-awaited user experience updates! And there will be plenty more of those coming soon!

[b]Changelog for Update #29 (ver. 0.8.59):[/b]

[h2]🌟 Overhaul for Ragna’s Flying 🌟[/h2]
🔷 Ragna can now boost her speed for a couple of seconds
🔷 Changed skill “Dragon Dash” to “Dragon Boost Plus” – enables chaining up to three flying boosts in a row if timed correctly
🔷 Ragna now charges kinetic energy while diving, and upon exiting the dive, she gains a high-speed temporary boost
🔷 Added and tweaked visual & audio effects while flying

[h2]😎 User Experience & Fixes 😎[/h2]
🔷 Added option to skip cutscenes
🔷 Added master volume slider in audio settings
🔷 Added camera auto-center on/off switch in controller settings
🔷 Characters’ flashlights now turn on in caves
🔷 Improved visual cues for enemy waves and color grading, similar to Seer encounters
🔷 Ragna now sees icons of discovered places from afar in Scout mode
🔷 Technology and skills icons are now bigger
🔷 Fixed environment at the edge of the island where players could fly inside and get stuck
🔷 Polished environment for Archseeker camp
🔷 Polished environment near the river on the second island
🔷 Polished environment for airship crash trail on the first island
🔷 Smaller environmental fixes for other islands
🔷 Added some missing icons
🔷 Various smaller fixes

We want to thank you for your patience and for playing our game! If you haven't joined our [url="https://discord.gg/GHFqg7NevH"]Discord[/url]
What are you waiting for? 😮

See ya soon,
Damian

notes.title: UPDATE #28: Pet the Steam Deck
notes.content:
[h1]HIA![/h1][p]
[/p][p]In this update, we are giving you the option to tame Ferins (and other animals in future updates). Tamed animals, when given shelter, will produce useful items. But first, you need to figure out how to do that :)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/e937486146fb348d98c545ba3869cd165b3276c7.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also made big improvements for [b]Steam Deck[/b] users. First Dwarf already has the “Playable” status, but we’re pushing further to get the “Verified”✅ badge. Now, when you launch the game on Steam Deck, everything should configure itself automatically. Savegame naming will bring up the on-screen keyboard right away, and text size should be better adjusted to the smaller screen. Enjoy a smoother and more comfortable experience!
[/p][p]If you're having trouble figuring out how to unlock the hidden tech needed for taming Ferins, here's a guide:
Spoilers Ahead!
[spoiler]To unlock Ferin Treats, you first need to heal a slightly tainted Ferin using the Taint Cleansing Bolt. Then, go to the Technology menu, and Ferin Treats should now be unlocked. To tame a Ferin, place the treats near it, but be careful not to scare it. If you are within its sight while it eats the treats, it will become tamed and no longer run away from you. Once tamed, you can lead the Ferin to the new structure called the Ferin Shelter. When everything needed is provided, the shelter will start producing Ferin Teeth.[/spoiler][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/87f8ee2ef8189a716a8245794041b18cdd03cdef.gif"][/img][/p][p]New Hidden Technology system – there will be some technologies that you will need to figure out how to unlock by finding something in the world, talking with an NPC, or doing something. More of this kind of tech will come in the next updates :)
[/p][h3]Changelog for Update #28 (ver. 0.8.54): [/h3][p]
[/p][h2]🌟HIGHLIGHTS🌟[/h2][p]🔷 New Ferin Taming mechanic[/p][p]🔷New Ferins will now be born in nests over time if their population drops below the island Ferin limit value.[/p][p]🔷 New Hidden Technology: [spoiler]Ferin Treats[/spoiler][/p][p]🔷 New Hidden Technology: [spoiler]Ferin Shelter[/spoiler][/p][p]🔷 Steam Deck Optimization[/p][list][p] 🔸 Auto-detect Steam Deck and set up display settings[/p][p] 🔸 Auto-detect Steam Deck and enable bigger UI[/p][p] 🔸 Steam Deck keyboard will appear automatically now[/p][/list][p]🔷 Changes to Tru’s swimming – you can now jump into water even if your stamina is 0. This should help with getting out of some wet situations.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES 🛠️[/h2][p]🔷 Hunters Guild – sometimes the objective “Acquire the raven” wouldn’t register as completed[/p][p]🔷 Easier path to the Resin Tree on the 1st island[/p][p]🔷 Removed duplicate dialogue on the first island: "Next time, we'll be more prepared."[/p][p]🔷 Fixed bug where there were two Ragnas in the first cutscene on the second island[/p][p]🔷 New, more detailed giant roots on the fifth island[/p][p]🔷 Fixed bug where "Build & Clear Area" didn’t actually clear the area[/p][p]🔷 Fixed bug with building walls on Canyon Island (there were places where the grid was green, but you couldn’t build walls anyway)[/p][p]🔷 Fixes to gate building – "Build & Clear Area" didn’t always clear the area correctly[/p][p]🔷 Environment and collision fixes on islands[/p][p]🔷 Scholars Guild bug fixed – when the player went to the third island but didn’t complete the questline, then proceeded to the fourth island, a bug occurred where two guilds would arrive on the fourth island at the same time, while the Scholars Guild stayed near the port on the third island. [b][u]This fix works only on new saves, unfortunately![/u][/b][/p][p]🔷 Fixes to destroying building animations[/p][p]🔷 Added sound effect for fully charged high jump in the mech[/p][p]🔷Fix for not auto-assigning ammo after picking it up[/p][p]🔷Fixed an issue where, with 0 crossbow ammo, the VFX from the previous ammo type(acid/lightning/resin/etc.) was still displayed.
[/p][p][b]We are working on the next BIG update with more taming, and finally some work for settlers! And maybe we’ll also meet someone new 😮[/b][/p][p]By the way - in case you missed it, we recently dropped a [i]small but mighty[/i] update packed with UX improvements, shortcuts, and bug fixes ⚙️. It’s not numbered like the big ones, but it made the game smoother in many ways. You can read the full notes here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1714900/view/515217690428704098"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]See you soon, adventurers![/p][p]Over and out <3[/p][p]Damian & .misha.[/p]

notes.title: User Experience Upgrade ⚙️
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Explorers![/h2]
[p]Sometimes it’s the small tweaks that make the biggest difference – and this update is packed with them. 😊
If you enjoy building quickly, navigating menus smoothly, or want your minimap to guide you exactly where to go, you’ll be happy with this one. Plus, we’ve squashed some bugs and made life easier![/p]
[p]Here’s what’s new and improved:[/p]

[h2]🌟HIGHLIGHTS🌟[/h2]
[p]🔷 [b]Quick Building Shortcuts[/b] – Press [1]-[9] in build mode to instantly select buildings in your current category. Icons now show their shortcut number right on screen.[/p]
[p]🔷 [b]RPG Menu Exit Shortcuts[/b] – Press the tab’s shortcut again (e.g., M for Map) to instantly return to the game.[/p]
[p]🔷 [b]Hold-to-Assign Points[/b] – Skill points and tech unlocks can now be assigned by holding the button, making it way faster to spend multiple points.[/p]
[p]🔷 [b]UI Improvements[/b] – Clearer “Available In” section in crafting, minimap objectives more visible at the edge of the circle, plus lots of little UX polish touches.[/p]

[h2]🛠️OTHER FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS🛠️[/h2]
[p]🔹 [b]Crafting Change[/b] – Taint Cleaning Bolt is now crafted in the Workstation, not the Alchemy Station.[/p]
[p]🔹 Research Center level 3 is now disabled (it had no new content but was still upgradable).[/p]
[p]🔹 Added exits from the lake on the 5th island.[/p]
[p]🔹 Fixed water on the 5th island so you no longer fall under it without any reaction.[/p]
[p]🔹 Fixed bug where using Taint Cleaning Extract on bee trees didn’t return the watering can.[/p]
[p]🔹 Fixed approach to Seer enemies on the 5th island.[/p]
[p]🔹 Terrain topology tweaks to prevent the player from getting stuck.[/p]
[p]🔹 Improved animation of repairing with the wrench when playing as Tru.[/p]
[p]🔹 Various smaller fixes and polish changes.[/p]

[p]Short, sweet, and straight to the point – but trust me, these changes will make your time in the game much smoother. 😉[/p]
[p]We’re putting this out as a small update, but in the meantime, we’re cooking up a bigger one. We just didn’t want to keep you waiting – especially since we’re also moving the game to the newest Unreal Engine version, which might slightly extend the timing of the next release.[/p]
[p]If you missed [b]Update #27[/b], it’s worth checking it out – it brought some big additions! 👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1714900/view/515216422280897826]Update #27 here[/url][/p]

[p]See you in the next update![/p]
[p][b].misha.[/b]
[i]Rock and Stone![/i] 🪨⚒️[/p]

notes.title: Update #27:🦊Paws & Battlements 🧱
notes.content:
[h3]Good Day![/h3][p][b]With every update, the game keeps getting better and better, we hope you’ll enjoy the fixes and new additions! 😊[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Many of you asked for stone walls, and we added them in the previous update, but why stop there? That’s why, in this update, we’re introducing a new special type of structure/wall called [b]Battlements[/b]!
They’re much stronger than other walls (and more expensive too), BUT they also act as platforms, making it easier to defend your base using ranged weapons!
One more important thing, they add more [b]visual variety[/b] for those (like me too) who like to tinker with the aesthetic side of settlements. 🙂[/p][p][/p][p]💡Battlements will get visual lifting in the next update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5135ae02d7cbc10abe95ece50b41d305858492fa.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We’ve always wanted to improve the wildlife in our game, but major bugs and other features kept getting in the way. I’m happy to inform you that we’ve finally started making changes!
From now on, [b]Ferins[/b] will roam the world, respond to the player, and search for food, water, shelter, and more. 😊[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d9a75d8b264f0841e583f665d1fea16ea0294b3c.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]The world should also feel more alive thanks to new improvements in [b]enemy AI[/b].
Lone monsters will now wander the world, and if they choose to, they’ll [b]taint[/b] the berry bushes.
This ties neatly into the Ferin AI: if a Ferin eats the tainted berries, it will get sick and eventually transform into a [b]monster version[/b], UNLESS you heal it with the new [b]Taint Cleansing Bolts[/b]! Then, it will become friendly to you.[/p][p][/p][p][i]💡Ferins, and other animals, will continue to receive upgrades in the near future. [/i][/p][p][i]💡Not all the monster have the ability for tainting the berries, Hunter Felfs can do that. This way this should be more balanced.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d2000ea7213bf4a70c681d8818f0e74face0512e.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We’ve also added the ability to [b]refuel mana[/b] through the [b]mana pipeline connections[/b]!
If you build a proper pipeline network across the island, there’ll be no need to search for mana springs anymore. 🙂[/p][p][/p][p]As for playable characters, we want to make traversing the islands easier, more enjoyable (and cooler).In this update, we’ve [b]upgraded jumping for the Mech[/b], you can now adjust jump height depending on how long you hold the jump button.
If you hold it long enough, you’ll charge it to the max. Only this max-charged jump will consume mana :)[/p][p][/p][p][i]💡Next in line are improvements to [b]Ragna's flying[/b], and after that, [b]Tru[/b] will finally get a cool way to travel across the islands![/i][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added [b]shortcuts to every tab[/b] in the RPG menu!
Please keep in mind this is still a work in progress—exiting the game using the shortcut for the current tab will be coming in the next update![/p][p][i]
💡 We’ll also be adding [b]numeric shortcuts for structures[/b] soon.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Oh, and thanks to your feedback, we’ve added the ability for [b]Tru[/b] to [b]swim[/b]!
A popular misconception is that dwarves don’t swim. The truth is, they do! They just don’t enjoy it much… but their pride, resilience, and stamina keep them afloat. 😄  [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the full list of improvements and fixes below.👇[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changelog for Update #27 (ver. 0.8[/b].[b]27):[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][h2]🌟HIGHLIGHTS🌟[/h2][p]🔷 [b]New Technology – Battlements[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]New Technology – Taint Cleansing Bolts[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]Adjustable High Jump ability for the Mech[/b] (depends on how long you hold the jump button)[/p][p]🔷 [b]Added new mechanic that allows the Mech to refuel mana[/b] at mana pipeline connections[/p][p]🔷 [b]Tru can swim now[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]Added shortcuts for all tabs in the RPG menu[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]Crows Improvements:[/b][/p][p]  💠 [b]Fixed collision for crows' nests and surrounding areas[/b] – they should no longer go underground

notes.title: Rock'n'Stone🪨 Update #26
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, explorers!🧭[/h2][p]We’re back with [b]Rock'n'Stone Update #26[/b], built together with you and for you. This time we’re bringing something many of you have been asking for: [b][u]Stone Walls[/u][/b]![/p][p]Until now, your settlements stood behind wooden palisades. Now it’s time to level up your defenses with solid rock. These new stone walls open up new ways to plan and fortify your base, and we can’t wait to see the creative layouts you’ll come up with.[/p][p]Alongside this, we’ve added more balance tweaks, fixes, and small improvements that make the world feel smoother and more alive, all inspired by your feedback.[/p][p]If you missed the [b][u]1st Anniversary Update[/u][/b], it introduced [b]the 5th island[/b], new story quests, tons of quality-of-life upgrades, and more. You can catch up on it here:[/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1714900/view/515213885413786214"][/dynamiclink][/h2][h2]🛠️[b]Update #26[/b] (build ver. 0.8.16)[/h2][p][/p][h2]🪨 Rock Walls![/h2][p]🔷 The first iteration of [b]Stone Defensive Walls[/b] is finally here. Stronger and more durable than wooden palisades, they are perfect for taking your settlement defense to the next level.[/p][p][/p][h2]🌟 Balance[/h2][p]🔷 [b]Spawners now drop pickups[/b] when destroyed
🔷 [b]Medium difficulty has been tweaked[/b]. It should feel more balanced and challenging with each new island
🔷 [b]Hard difficulty has also been adjusted[/b] to deliver a more balanced and challenging experience as you progress
🔷 There are [b]more active spawners on the 5th island[/b] (four slightly tainted that will activate over time and four active from the start)
🔷 Enemy nests in the Acid Cave on the 4th island now spawn stronger enemy versions on medium and hard difficulties. They also create them faster and in higher numbers[/p][p][/p][h2]⚡ Performance & Optimization[/h2][p]🔷 Optimization pass including LOD improvements for architecture, AI, and optimized animation bones
🔷 You should see higher FPS, especially when your settlement grows or during big enemy waves[/p][p][/p][h2]⚙️ Other Improvements & Feautures[/h2][p]🔷[b]New walls - Stone Wall[/b] [/p][p]🔷[b]New technology[/b] - Resin Bolt (It leaves a sticky, resin-based liquid that slows down enemies who stand on it)[/p][p]🔷 [b]Improvements to the crafting menu.[/b] The interface now hints if items in a given category can be crafted at a different crafting station
🔷 [b]New cutscenes[/b][/p][p]  💠 Sending the raven for settlers [/p][p]  💠 Settlers' arrival [/p][p]🔷 New visuals for settlers from the Berserkers Guild

notes.title: 1st Anniversary Update (#25)
notes.content: [h2]🎉Wow, it’s already been a year![/h2][p]Huge thanks to everyone who played, supported us, shared feedback, or just had fun in First Dwarf. [/p][p]This journey has been wild, unpredictable, and incredibly rewarding. Your ideas and reports have shaped the game in ways we never imagined. You’re not just the community. [/p][h3]You’re part of the dev team![/h3][p][/p][h2]🚀How Far We’ve Come[/h2][p]Over the past year, the game has grown massively. The world is now four times bigger. We’ve added new islands, weapons, technologies, character progression, and entire clans arriving with fresh challenges. You asked for more freedom in building, so we made it possible for the mech, Tru, and Ragna to all build. You asked for better UI, stamina balance, clearer notifications, easier wall and mana-pipe placement, and we delivered. We added a flying ship, full Steam Deck support, and cloud saves. That’s 25 updates so far, and honestly, we’re just getting started.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0f920deba9162aa7e33e5fe3465db35a5ed481f8.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🛠️Update #25 [b](build ver. 0.8)[/b][/h2][p]To celebrate the 1st Anniversary Update (#25), we’re unlocking something special: [b][u]early access to the fifth island[/u][/b]. It’s still under development, but to celebrate the first anniversary of Early Access, we’re letting you explore it now and get a sneak peek at what’s coming. [/p][p]And for those who want to jump straight into testing new features, we’re also including a [b][u]special savegame with everything unlocked in the technology tab[/u][/b] and ready to play around with. This is just for those who want to experiment quickly and freely. [/p][p][/p][h2]🌟HIGHLIGHTS[/h2][p]🔷 [b]New 5th island unlocked[/b] [i](Work in Progress)[/i][/p][p]🔷 [b]Settlers can now repair damaged structures[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]New Berserkers guild introduced[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]New monster: Flufgig[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c9e1d5ad4cc3102afe876534534a52d97fc26122.gif"][/img][/p][p]🔷 [b]Crafting stations now support item queueing[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]Ragna can now fly much closer to the ground[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]New pickup: Crystallised Mana[/b][/p][p][b]🔷 New technologies:[/b][/p][p][b]⠀⠀[/b]💠Rippergun[/p][p][b]⠀⠀[/b]💠Mana Infusion[/p][p][b]⠀⠀[/b]💠Spiked Wall[/p][p][b]⠀⠀[/b]💠Whetstone[/p][p][b]⠀⠀[/b]💠Blast Trap[/p][p][b]⠀⠀[/b]💠Explosive Cartridges[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/1c90b0a24f2456f3deaf17b1f398e2147a357560.gif"][/img][/p][h2]⚙️Features[/h2][p]🔷 [b]New skills added:[/b][/p][p]⠀⠀💠 Ragna The Engineer[/p][p]⠀⠀💠 Tru The Alchemist[/p][p]⠀⠀💠 Firebreath Mastering[/p][p]⠀⠀💠 Fireball Mastering[/p][p]⠀⠀💠 Frostbreath[/p][p]⠀⠀💠 Frostbreath Mastering[/p][p]🔷 [b]The main base flag now reflects your Dwarven Guild[/b][/p][p]🔷 [b]Destroyed structures now appear scorched and no longer show HP bars or prompts unnecessarily[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]🧩User Experience[/h2][p]🔷 New, clearer pop-up window in the skills menu[/p][p]🔷 Adjusted drop rates for monster pickups[/p][p]🔷 All characters can now pick up equipment, even if they can't equip it[/p][p][/p][h2]🐞Fixes[/h2][p]🔷 You can now pick up duplicate equipment[/p][p]🔷 Settlers no longer get stuck between defensive walls[/p][p]🔷 Fixed settlers wandering off while talking to the player[/p][p]🔷 Several skills now have improved descriptions[/p][p][/p][h2]🔮So, what’s next? [/h2][p]✨First, we’re diving deep into [b][u]NPC and wildlife AI[/u][/b]. In this update, settlers can already repair damaged buildings on their own, and they’ll gain more autonomous roles in future updates. We’re also bringing life to wild, untainted animals. [/p][p]✨Next up is [b][u]combat variety[/u][/b]. Enemies will get new attack behaviors, new abilities, and entirely new types. You’ll see the first hints of this already, with a brand new enemy and upgraded combat for Ragna. [/p][p]✨Village infrastructure is another big focus. Expect [b][u]new structures, expanded building features[/u][/b], and more depth to how your settlements evolve. After improving wall placement, the next step is adding new wall types. [/p][p]✨And speaking of heroes, this [b][u]update boosts Ragna. Next in line is Tru[/u][/b]. We’re also working on key new NPCs like Val and Lyra, and eventually, you’ll meet our future arch-nemesis, Astramos.[/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks for all the great feedback and bug reports![/p][p][b]Come hang out with us on [url="https://discord.gg/GHFqg7NevH"]Discord[/url] [/b]🧝‍♂️🧙‍♀️🛡️🧑‍🔧🤖🐗🪄⛏️[/p][p].misha. + Damian[/p]

We have made a lot of improvements to the building, but also added the long awaited (by us at least :D) notification system. It still needs some polishing, but at last you will get info about many important things in the game and finally you will see the names of the monsters when you spot them :)

Combat should now feel more challenging, we have made a lot of balance changes to the way stamina works in the game. I hope you like the changes.

notes.title: Update #22: Build Tight, Shoot Right!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there![/h2]
It's high time for a fresh update 😎 And as every proper Dwarf knows - nothing beats tighter walls and a well-oiled crossbow 💪  
This time, we’ve focused on improving the building system. Most importantly, the grid is now 2x denser, making creative building easier and helping structures fit more snugly into the environment. On top of that, gate placement has been improved - you can now place them at more varied angles and in different lengths 😊

But if you're more of a warrior Dwarf, we hope you'll enjoy the shooting improvements we've added to the game :)

[b]Here’s the full changelog for Update #22 (ver. 0.724):[/b]

[h3][b]🌟Highlights🌟[/b][/h3]
[list]
💠 Smaller, more precise grid  
💠 New gate-building system - more gate angles and lengths  
[previewyoutube=VX9eqaVTjN4;full][/previewyoutube]
💠 Crossbow and gunfeel overhaul  
[list]
🔸 New functionality: drawing the crossbow increases accuracy and range  
🔸 New animations: Fully Charged, Charging, Reload  
🔸 Unique crossbow-specific aiming reticle  
🔸 New sound effects  
[/list]
💠 Smooth stamina regeneration (not in chunks)  
[/list]

[h3][b]🛠️Other Changes & Fixes🛠️[/b][/h3]

💠 Ravens have a new, more magical nest now

🔸 New walking and running for Felf (the first enemy type)

[b]Greetings!

[b]We’re excited to present the brand-new update for First Dwarf!

Now, when building walls, you can switch between Drawing Mode and Align Mode. notes.title: Update #19: The Seer Awakens
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Dwarven Explorers![/h2]

We know, we know - this update took a little longer to land than our usual rapid-fire January sprint, where we threw out two major updates, a small one, and a hotfix like a dwarven forge on overdrive. But trust us, it was for a good reason! This time, we tackled some serious mechanical changes, and breaking them into smaller bits would have been messier than a goblin’s cooking.

The wait is over, and we’re really happy with what we’ve built! New UI improvements, better quest tracking, a whole village makeover, and a mysterious new enemy—the Seer! We hope you’ll love these changes as much as we do. Let’s dive in!

[h2]🌟 Update Highlights[/h2]

[h3]🌀 New Monster – Seer the Awoken[/h3]
A long-lived, levitating entity with powerful telepathic abilities. Seers act as silent watchers over vast territories, relaying information to their kind through mind-linking. Few have survived an encounter with a Seer—most challengers are driven insane by their whispers. They release a corrupted mist that distorts reality and camouflages their presence, making them even harder to detect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0d4371f1da5674e518b14aa3ceffff8836fe8b25.png[/img]
[h3]📜 Better Quest Menu[/h3]
You can now browse completed quests, a previously missing feature! Additionally, quests can be filtered freely, and we’ve introduced a clear distinction between Main and Side Quests for easier navigation.

[h3]🎮 Improved UI for Steam Deck Players[/h3]
Buildings now have short & long descriptions for better readability.
Enhanced windows & interface adjustments for a smoother experience.

[h3]🏗️ Contextual Hints During Building[/h3]
On-screen cursor-based tips now appear in real time, making construction more intuitive.

[h3] 👧 Settlers Rework[/h3]
The dwarven ladies got a much-needed revamp! 💪 New faces, improved animations, and more variety bring extra life to the settlement. Even in a world of floating islands, mechanical war machines, and dark tainted magic, looking your best still matters! 💅
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/dfc74645d1d76f7edf7d0528ac6112b2f2a50bcc.png[/img]
[h3]🌙 Visual Enhancements – Better Post-Processing & Lighting[/h3]
We’ve added improved post-processing effects, enhanced shadows, and refined ambient occlusion (AO). Night scenes now look better than ever, with richer lighting and a deeper atmosphere!

[h2]🔥 Full Changelog (ver 0.701)[/h2]

Let us know what you think of Seer and the latest improvements! 🛠️

Stay strong, Dwarves!

notes.title: Update #18: 💖Hearts & Hammers
notes.content:
[h2]💖 Love, War & Fixes – Update #18![/h2]
Hey, Dwarven pioneers! There’s no better time to team up than now. [b]Steam’s Couch Co-Op[/b] Event is here, bringing a [b]co-op discount[/b] and the perfect excuse to grab a partner and dive into the world of F[b]irst Dwarf[/b]. Whether you're building, fighting, or just making sure the other person doesn’t waste all your resources, [b]Update #18[/b] has a lot to offer.

[h3]🔥 Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Stat Windows for Buildings, Items, and Weapons – highly requested details on costs and effects. No more guesswork!
[*] Better Attack Patterns for Enemy Waves – less predictable, more natural. Now they won't just pile on one pre-determined spot.
[*] Updated Quests – clearer objectives, polished dialogues and better guidance
[/list][h3]
⚙️ Additional Features & Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Acid damage no longer cancels your combo – keep swinging!
[*] Updated quest icons on the UI – check the top-left corner.
[*] Environmental polishing – added a new path from Archseeker to the lower segment of Canyon Island.
[*] HP, Mana, and Stamina bars cleaned up – clearer, neater, and easier to read.
[*] Fixed area-wide quest detection when settling an island – smoother quest progression.
[*] Tree chopping FX now appears in the right place, even for oddly shaped trees – realism at its finest.
[*] Wild Wave base scoring fixed – no more weird 1/0 Felf waves.
[*] Camera adjustments – fewer awkward angles when colliding with trees.
[*] Wild Wave egg flight time now scales with difficulty:
[list][*] Easy – 33% more time before enemy wave
[*] Hard – 33% less time before enemy wave[/list][*] Fixed visual glitches in forests – no more flickering foliage.
[/list]
[h3]🔮 What’s Next?[/h3]
We’re far from done. More mechanics and fresh content are on the way, but the biggest change is something that has been missing until now. Characters with real roles in the world.

Speaking of which…
[h3]💘 Meet Val and Lyra – A Valentine’s Surprise![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/13372cc43e5ad266e2dd509db3cbfca3cac5769a.png[/img]
So far, the colonists have been just that. People settling the islands and working in the background. But among them are key figures with their own stories, goals, and conflicts. With upcoming updates, these NPCs will become more than just settlers. You will get to know them, interact with them, and understand their motivations, relationships, and the challenges they face. The first two to step into the spotlight are Val and Lyra. But they won’t be the last.

First up, Val. An aspiring geomancer and healer, scheduled to arrive later with the Survivalist Guild. Due to her beliefs, instincts, and readiness to act, she built her own airship and flew after Tru as soon as she could. She cares deeply for her people, including her childhood friend Tru, with whom she shared many youthful adventures. She will be joining the game soon, though not necessarily in the next update, bringing new interactions, fresh dynamics, and her own unique perspective on the world.

Later, with the arrival of the 5th island, comes Lyra. She is a lone elven figure with a past as mysterious as the Taint she once fought. She carries her burdens in silence, but her story will be one worth uncovering.

So grab your co-op partner, double-check your defenses, and get ready for whatever Driftland throws your way. Just remember, sometimes the biggest battles aren’t fought with hammers and dragonfire, but with trust and partnership.

🚀 See you in Driftland!

notes.title: Update #16 Community Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hey,[/h2]
We’re excited to bring you Update #16: Community Update, where we’ve taken your feedback (and a healthy dose of your fantastic ideas) to make First Dwarf a game closer to what we all know it [i]can[/i] be. Your input has been invaluable, whether pointing out what needs fixing or sharing creative suggestions that inspired some of this update’s key features. 
Thank you for being such an essential part of shaping the game’s journey! Here’s what’s new:

[h2]🛠️Changelog (Build Version 0.634)🛠️[/h2]

[h3]Highlights ✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bigger EXP rewards from higher-tier enemies[/b] – your battles with tougher foes will now feel even more rewarding!
[*] [b]Enemy waves and nests are now displayed on the map[/b] – with a Raven in the [b]Raven Watchtower[/b], you can now track enemy waves and their nests.
[*] [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b] – starting with this update, all new savegames will be stored in the cloud. To add your older savegames to the cloud, simply load them and save again.
[*] [b]Steam Deck Support (Beta)[/b] – enjoy First Dwarf on the go with beta support for Steam Deck. The game should now be fully playable, with all features supported, including online co-op. However, splitscreen co-op on a single Steam Deck isn’t quite perfect yet due to the amount of information displayed on the screen. Additionally, graphics quality settings are not yet automatically optimized for Steam Deck – you’ll need to adjust them manually.
[*] New [b]Icons for blueprints[/b] item icons and blueprint icons now have distinct visuals to improve clarity.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c28e0a04863affd845ce59e2e93d266ad09d9a6f.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Features 🚀[/h3]
[list][*]Monsters that spits acid will drop acid item now
[*] New Visual Effects for glowing orb nests – experience enhanced visuals with improved effects for glowing orb nests!
[*] Tech Waves attacks will now focus on Research Centers and area oround it.
[*] Improved enemy wave targeting – enemies in waves (wild and tech) will now attack buildings within the wave radius instead of roaming across the entire map. A visual indicator for the radius will be added in the next update.
[*] Environment fixes – resolved an issue where players could fly under the ground in the cave on Canyon Island.
[*] Quest fix for "New Challenges" – you can now obtain the Research Center. This works if you start a new game or load a save from before the quest.
[*] Game balance – adjusted some chest rewards on Swamp Island.
[*] Enemy stuck behavior fixed – enemies will get stuck less often, and in cases where they do, they’ll now be destroyed.
[*] Input reset fix – fixed a controller bug after switching characters.
[*] Environmental object fixes – addressed instances where parts of objects disappeared.
[*] Updated Raven Watchtower description – now more aligned with new feeautures.
[*] Dragon Weed description fix – now displays correctly.
[*] More environment improvements on the 4th island – polishing up visuals for the next adventure!
[*] Animation improvements – Tru’s repair animation is now smoother.
[*] New voiceovers for the second Guild Chief.
[*] Added Owl death animation.
[/list]
Last week, we released Update #15🚀, which some players might have missed since it was marked as a "small update" on Steam. Current Update #16 is the second update this month, so it’s easy to see how the earlier one might have flown under the radar. 
[h3]🛠️Changelog (Build Version 0.626)🛠️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new paths leading to the bottom of the canyon on the Ruptured Canyon island
[*] Added acid status when you are inside the acid fog
[*] Fixed bug where game cursor was not visible while playing on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed cases were some that were unable to open or their rewards picked up
[*] Fixed cases where Raven didn't fly to Main Base or Raven Watchtower
[*] Fixed some collisions for the swamp island environment
[*] Fixes for visible prompt for petting the animals that can't be pet
[*] Fixed error where "use" prompts were wrongly visible for items blueprints
[*] Fixed disappearing weapons when using a whistle while in the Mech
[*] Fixed instances where enemies didn't attack Ragna with ranged attacks
[*] Fixed cases where enemies were stuck near the canyon on the Ruptured Canyon island
[*] Fixed bug where you couldn't fly ship and Ragna
[*] Improved environment visuals for a new island
[/list]

We’re incredibly thankful for your feedback, which helps us make First Dwarf the best experience possible. Please keep sharing your ideas with us – we’re listening!
We’re not slowing down – there are already new features in development and testing, and you can expect the next update to arrive soon, definitely later this month. Your suggestions and support continue to inspire us, and we can’t wait to share more exciting updates with you. Until then, happy building, exploring, and dwarfing!

Forge on, brave dwarves, on Driftland!
The Star Drifters Team 🚀

notes.title: 🎄Update #14 ho Ho HO!❄️
notes.content:
[h3]Hey,[/h3]

The holidays🎄 have arrived in Driftland, and we've got a fresh batch of goodies to keep you warm (and slightly chaotic) through the season. Get ready for festive vibes, new items, and plenty of surprises that will only stick around until January 10, 2025. Let's dive into what's new!

[h3]🎄 Event Features (Limited Time Only!)[/h3]
[list]
 ❄️ [b]Build Your Own Christmas Tree[/b] — Add a touch of holiday magic to your island by placing and decorating your very own Christmas tree. It's a seasonal special, so don't miss your chance to bring some festive charm to Driftland.
 ❄️ [b]Monsters in Santa Hats[/b] — Some sneaky creatures managed to "borrow" Santa's hats. Keep an eye out for them — they might be up to something!
 ❄️ [b]New Consumable: Candy Cane[/b] — Sweet, crunchy, and unexpectedly useful. Candy Cane restores +300 HP for Tru and Ragna. It's only available during the event, and it drops from certain enemies. Get 'em while you can!
[/list]
[h3]🎉 New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Side Quest "Thunder in Paradise"
[*] New crafting Item: Electric Gel — it drops from electric type enemies after you finish "Thunder in Paradise" sidequest.
[*] New Chests with pickups on 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Islands.
[/list]
[h3]⚔️ Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crossbow UI Hints Improved 
[olist][*]Contextual hints for the crossbow added. They explain how to aim and shoot, 
[*]Added bolts counter to the UI.
[*]Crossbow slot now shows what bolts are equipped.[/olist][*]Enemy Drop System Improved 
[olist][*]Enemies and animals now have a proper pickup animation for drops. 
[*]Higher-level enemies have a greater chance of dropping rare items.[/olist][*] BigFelf's Acid Attack Buff — BigFelf’s acid attack now inflicts an additional +5 acid damage for 3 seconds. Watch your step!
[/list]
[h3]🏝️ Environment & Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] 4th Island ruins update — Visual enhancements to the ruins’ landscape. We’ve added stones and closed up some awkward gaps.
[*] Island Adjustments — 4th Island got some extra love. We’ve refined the layout of spawners and hidden those "what's-that-hole-doing-there" gaps. It’s a cleaner, more polished experience.
[/list]
[h3]🛠️ Fixes & Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resource Drop Adjustments — Picking up Acid pickup flowers in caves is now easier.
[*] Improved Item Pickup — Grabbing items on Mushroom Island has been refined for smoother collection.
[*] Fixed Iron Mine Placement — An issue reported by the community where an Iron Mine on Mushroom Island couldn’t be built due to a collision with a Mana Well has been resolved.
[*] Coral Respawn Timer — Coral now respawns every 24 minutes as intended.
[*] Fixed Trigger Issue — The trigger will now correctly disappear after retrieving the navigation stone.
[*] Enemy Reaction Time — Enemies at spawners sometimes took a little too long to notice you. They’re more alert now — you’ve been warned.
[*] Fixed Enemy Response to Perfect Block — Enemies no longer react when you perform a perfect block on their projectile attacks.
[*] Mana Well Interaction Fix — If you’ve unlocked a distillery but didn’t build it, you’ll no longer be blocked from collecting mana from a Mana Well.
[*] Improved AI at Spawners — Enemy spawners on the 4th island have been tweaked for better alignment with the landscape, walls, and stones.
[*] Ship’s Storm Effect for Player 2 — The storm effect will now properly trigger for Player 2 on the ship.
[*] and many more minor fixes and tweaks
[/list]
Check out the highlight reel showcasing the key features and fresh content introduced with the 4th island update! 📺✨
[previewyoutube=jQ5fWd81HKs;full][/previewyoutube]
That’s it for this update! Dive in, grab your Candy Cane, and deck the islands with Christmas trees. But remember — all event content vanishes after January 10, 2025.

Have a fantastic holiday season, and see you in Driftland!

notes.title: 🚀 Update #13: New Horizons, New Heights!
notes.content:
[h2]Adventurers of Driftland,[/h2]

Time to stretch those mechanical legs - Update #13 has landed! With it, we’re officially moving from version 0.5xx to 0.6xx. Why the shift? It’s all about the arrival of the shiny new 4th Island! 🏝️

This isn’t just "another island". It’s our first step into a bolder, more layered world. The 4th Island brings a fresh visual vibe, introduces a whole new vertical structure, and adds some fresh challenges to keep things interesting. It’s the beginning of something bigger, and yes, this island will continue to evolve in upcoming updates.

But that’s not all! We’ve been busy behind the scenes cooking up new features, taking inspiration straight from your feedback. Some of these ideas are already live in this update, while others are planned for future releases as part of the 0.6xx update series. And yes, work on the 5th Island is already in motion. So stay tuned - there’s plenty more to come.

Alright, enough talk. Let’s get into the good stuff. Here’s what’s fresh in Update #13:

[h2]Full Change Log Version 0.610[/h2]

[h2]🌴 New Island: Welcome to the 4th Island![/h2]
Behold the biggest highlight of Update #13 - the arrival of the 4th Island! Here’s what makes it truly special:[list]
🌄 Vertical design: Unlike any previous islands, this new island is built with layers and elevation, creating a new level of vertical exploration and strategic building. Get ready for a whole new way to approach construction and combat.
🎨 A fresh, visual refresh: This island brings a new aesthetic vibe to Driftland—new biomes, updated foliage, and more dynamic, natural structures make every moment here feel like an adventure.
🔓 New quests, new challenges, and more adventure: New objectives await, and with them, fresh gameplay twists and surprises.[/list]The 4th Island is only the beginning of what’s to come as we continue our journey in the 0.6.x era. Prepare for more content, features, and surprises in the updates to follow!

[h2]✨ What’s New?[/h2]
[list]
[h3] 🔹 Crosshair for Precision Building[/h3]
[list]A small change with big impact—now there’s a crosshair in the center of the screen when building, making it far easier to place objects exactly where you want them.[/list] [h3]🔹 Enemy Item Drops[/h3]
[list]Enemies now drop items after you unlock new technologies. You’ll want to hunt them down and see what treasures they’re hiding![/list][h3] 🔹 Favorite Recipes in Crafting Stations[/h3]
[list]Sick of scrolling? We’ve got you. You can now mark recipes as favorites in crafting stations, making your go-to blueprints faster to find and easier to manage.[/list][h3] 🔹 Area Damage for Hammer Special Attacks[/h3]
[list]The hammer just got mightier. Now special attacks from hammer-type weapons deal area damage, so you can smash through multiple enemies in one powerful swing.[/list][/list]
[h2]🔬 New Technology Tree Items[/h2]
More tools, weapons, and consumables to expand your playstyle and strategy. Here’s what’s new in the Tech Tree:[list]
🛡️ [Weapon] Dwarfen Mech Crossbow – Precision, power, and versatility packed into one ranged powerhouse.
💥 [Consumable] Standard Bolts – Essential ammo for the Dwarfen Mech Crossbow.
💥 [Consumable] Acid Bolts – Splash some extra damage on your enemies with these powerful, corrosive bolts.
🍷 [Consumable] Attack Up Potion – Boost your attack power and become an unstoppable force.
🛡️ [Consumable] Defense Up Potion – Take more hits and stay in the fight longer with this defensive brew.[/list]
[h2]🌱 New Plants[/h2]
More flora, more fun. Here’s what’s sprouting up on Driftland:[list]
🌿 Dragon Weed – A fiery-looking plant with some potent properties.
🍄 Mushroom Flowers – Strange hybrids that are as unusual as they are useful.
🧪 Acid Shroom – Handle with care. This one’s got a bite to it.[/list]
[h2]⚙️ New Crafting Materials[/h2]
To create more, you’ll need to gather more. Here’s what’s new in the world of crafting resources:
[list]
🦷 Monster Tooth – The perfect trophy... and also a key material for crafting.
🧪 Acid – Corrosive, dangerous, and oh-so-useful for certain creations.
🐺 Fur – Soft, fuzzy, and essential for several crafting recipes.
💎 Plasma (rare) – A rare find with massive potential in crafting upgrades.
🦄 Monster Horn (rare) – Not every beast has one, but you’ll want to grab it when they do.
🕸️ Monster Spike (rare) – Sharp, deadly, and ready to be turned into something special.[/list]
[h2]🐛 Fixes[/h2]
Here’s what we’ve cleaned up to make the world of Driftland more stable and fun:[list]
🔧 Quest Visibility Bugs – Fixed issues where quests wouldn’t check off when finished, sometimes wouldn’t appear at all, or weren’t visible to co-op partners.
🔧 Attack from Above – Resolved an issue where attacks from above wouldn’t register as hits.
🔧 Anchor Spot Animation – Anchor Spots now display their proper building animation.[/list]
[h2]🧪 Experimental[/h2]
[list]🔹 Intuitive Wall and Mana-Pipe BuildingWe’re working on a brand-new system to make building walls and mana pipes faster, more straightforward, and more intuitive. As an early look at this system, you can now hold down the build button to continuously build wall segments one after another. This is an experimental feature, so let us know how it feels![/list][previewyoutube=jQ5fWd81HKs;full][/previewyoutube]
The 4th Island is just the beginning of the journey into the 0.6.x era of First Dwarf. With every update, we’ll be introducing even more features, systems, and surprises leading up to the monumental arrival of the 5th Island. But for now, it’s time to explore the layered, vertical world of the 4th Island and see what’s waiting for you.

Your feedback is essential - so if you’ve got thoughts, ideas, or epic stories to share, we’re all ears on Steam and Discord!

Happy exploring,
The First Dwarf Team

notes.content:
[h1]Adventurers of Driftland,[/h1]

We’re thrilled to bring you Update #12, a pivotal step in First Dwarf’s journey! This update lays the groundwork for the highly anticipated 0.6x milestone, coming later this year, complete with a brand-new island and exciting features. But before we take that leap, we’ve focused on introducing fundamental changes to the game’s core mechanics to make your experience more satisfying than ever.

[h3]⚠️IMPORTANT NOTICE⚠️[/h3]
We’ve made significant tweaks to the leveling system, the old boosts that were pretty overpowered. *For now* your current stats won’t change upon loading, the new system will activate after reaching new level, but previous levels will be calculated with old system. So we highly recommend to start a new game if you want to feel the new flow. 

[h3]🧙‍♂️ RECOMMENDATION:[/h3] To fully experience the improved leveling mechanics, we suggest starting a new game! (But don’t worry, it’s not mandatory if you’re more excited to jump into the other features.)

[h3]💡 Your Feedback Is Magical:[/h3] As always, your input helps us shape First Dwarf into the game you’ll love even more. Let us know what you think in the Steam Community forums!

Now that you’ve been properly warned and prepared, let’s dive into the details:

[h1]Full Change Log Version 0.568[/h1]

[h3]New Features and Changes[/h3]
🔹 [b]Difficulty Levels[/b]
The long-awaited difficulty system is here! Choose the level of challenge that suits your playstyle. This is our first iteration, and we’re eager to hear your feedback—let us know if it improves your gameplay flow and satisfaction with progress.

🔹[b]Crafting Menus Overhaul | part 1[/b]
The Crafting menus in Workshop, Alchemy Station, and Forge have been revamped and improved for better usability. Please have in mind that this will be expanded. Features like crafting queuing are already being developed. Keep your suggestions coming!

🔹 [b]New Badass Tru[/b]
Tru has undergone a complete visual overhaul, bringing even more personality and heroism to your adventures.

🔹 [b]Enhanced Visual Feedback[/b]
✨ Added new visual effects and indicators for corrupted spawners and meteor-triggered spawners.
✨ Enemies will now display 0, 1, or 2 skulls below their HP bars to indicate their difficulty tier.

🔹 [b]Improved Co-op Experience[/b]
There is now a 125 metre (about 25 grid squares) safe radius around the player who hosted the game, which will prevent players who joined as a client from fading to black and respawning.

🔹 [b]Grid Improvement[/b]
Enemy corpses will no longer block the building grid, making base building/rebuilding easier during times of pressure such as enemy waves.

🔹 [b]Added 10% dmg resistance for each piece of Mech Battle Armor Set[/b]

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
🚀 Performance Boosts
Enjoy smoother gameplay, even during massive battles, thanks to new optimizations.

[h3]AI Improvements[/h3]
🔹 Settlers Interaction Fixes
Settlers will now finish their conversations with you before returning to their homes at night or going about their business.

🔹 Settlers will follow you during dialogues if you wander off

🔹 Improved Enemy Waves AI
Enemies will be less likely to target the same spot, they will spread out more, which should create more interesting base defence scenarios.

[h3]🎥 Updated Intro Cutscene[/h3]
✨ Featuring: Tru’s handsome new look.
✨ Small camera angle tweaked in second scene.
✨ Fixed visible pickups effects during the cutscene.

[h3]Audio and Visual Improvements[/h3]
🎵 [b]SFX Adjustments[/b]
Footstep sounds have been reduced: 20% quieter for running and 40% for walking (Tru and Mech).

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
🐛 Monster Nest Slot Bars below hp indicator now will be displayed correctly.
🐛 Resolved an issue where charged slots in monster nests didn’t spawn enemies after being hit.
🐛 Typo Corrections: Thanks to @Fulgur from our Discord for spotting a typo—fixed!
🐛The “Improvement is the Key” quest now progresses correctly during the second island transition, based on feedback on our Discord @Bravo!
🐛Gaianas (those Big floating creatures) will no longer disappear when moving slightly off-screen.


This update sets the stage for the [b]0.6x release[/b], bringing new horizons to explore and fresh challenges to conquer. Until then, dive into Update #12 and please let us know how these changes enhance your adventure!

PS. (from Damian) I would like to thank all the people who have given us their feedback in our Steam Discussion tab recently! It helped to create some cool improvements (like, in my opinion), the visual effects on the monster nests with LOTR vines :) Lord THEN, Dragon, /!\Kapudd and everyone who shared their feedback, thank you! 

Happy exploring,
The First Dwarf Team

notes.title: Update #11: A New Chapter in on-line Co-op
notes.content:
[h2]This may seem like a small update for First Dwarf, but it’s a giant leap for our online co-op mode! 🚀[/h2]

With Update #11, we’re introducing a literally game-changing feature: players can now independently access their maps, character menus, and item screens without pausing the action for their co-op partner. As one player navigates menus, the other will see a floating, semi-transparent screen in front of their companion, displaying exactly what they’re doing. For example, if Tru is studying the map, Ragna will see Tru standing still with a map projection hovering at eye level, an immersive way to keep both players in sync. 🗺️✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/61c59f5f52dd71fd639b241b40e59fc71b02cf1a.gif[/img]

This feature is being rolled out in beta, as we’re still fine-tuning the system to ensure it’s as polished as possible. While functional, you might notice some minor visual quirks in the Character menu under specific conditions, though these won’t impact gameplay. We’d love to hear your feedback as we refine this exciting addition! 💬

[previewyoutube=2fBMIda7OVw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Full Change Log Version 0.555[/h3]

[list]
[*] Independent menu access for online co-op players 🎮
[*] Floating screen projections for co-op immersion 🌟
[*] Ragna's Fine-Tuning Continues
[list]
[*] New animations for Ragna: sideways flying during aim 🦅
[*] Faster idle animations for Ragna ⚡
[*] Adjusted Ragna's head-turning: now only active during fire breath and fireball attacks 🔥 (disabled for aim and scout modes)
[*] Ragna flaps wings when sprinting during straight flight 🕊️
[/list][*] Minor islands polish for smoother building 🛠️
[*] Improvements to blocking and perfect blocking in melee combat for Tru and The Mech
[*] Minor bug fixes 🐛
[*] Core optimizations for smoother gameplay ⚙️
[/list]

[h3]What’s Next for First Dwarf[/h3]

As Update #11 rolls out, we’re already working on exciting changes coming in the next updates! Here’s a preview of what’s ahead:

[list]
[*] Gameplay enhancements: We’ll introduce difficulty levels, allowing you to tailor the challenge to your play style. 🎯
[*] Redesign of Tru: Our beloved dwarf is getting a visual and functional upgrade to fit even better into Driftland's evolving world. 🛠️
[*] Performance optimization: We hope the game will run smoother in most scenarios. 🚀
[*] New island and clan: A new area to explore, complete with a fresh clan and unique challenges, is coming. 🏝️
[*] Story-rich characters: Supporting characters will soon step into the spotlight, deepening the story and enriching the world of Driftland. 📜✨
[/list]

And much more to keep the adventure fresh and exciting!

[h3]Farewell to Spooktober 🎃[/h3]

Meanwhile, all good things must come to an end. As 🎃 Spooktober draws to a close, Driftland will bid farewell to its seasonal spooky flair. Pumpkins and Spooktober touches will disappear into the mists... or will they return next year? 👻

However, we’ve decided to leave the autumn colors on the trees a bit longer to keep the cozy atmosphere alive. 🍂

We hope you enjoyed the seasonal changes and spooky surprises. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re excited to hear what you think about Update #11 and the adventures ahead. Let’s keep building Driftland together! 🏗️💪

Happy co-oping! 🌍🤝
Star Drifters Team 🌟🚀

Their arrival is always with consequence. [b]Wherever the Gaianas appear, significant events soon follow.[/b] They bring change—sometimes for good, sometimes for ill. Their immense presence stirs the flow of mana, disrupting magic itself and altering the balance of the world.

Hello Adventurers!

Before the week ends, we’re here with the new patch for First Dwarf. We made a lot of fixes which we believe will improve the playability of the game. As always, thank you for all the reports you’re making. Thanks to you, we can act quickly and take care of them right away. As we are a small team, we’re testing the game ourselves and sometimes it’s hard to catch all of those nasty bugs.

[h2]Full Change Log (Version 0.417):[/h2]
[list]
[*] New animations and visual effects for using consumables added
[/list][b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed blocked Mana Spring on the 3rd island
[*] Fixed blocked Quarry on the 3rd island
[*] Archseeker’s voice is now louder
[*] Plant Fiber and Thread crafting recipes are unlocked from the start
[*] Fixed Iron Deposit next to Archseeker being visually underground
[*] Map and minimap fixes:
[list][*] Smaller islands near the 2nd island are now visible on map and minimap
[*] Fixed - forest on the 2nd island not being placed correctly on minimap
[*] Fixed - forests on 3rd island not being visible on minimap
[*] Map of the 3rd island is no longer slightly shifted
[*] Eskoim turrets have no longer a house icon on minimap
[*] Eskoim houses now have icons on minimap
[/list][*] Fixed mana bar not being visually full
[*] Fixed - some of the monsters were shooting through walls
[*] Bigger radius for Ragna returning to the Airship
[*] Fixed issue with being unable to talk to the Guild Chief that occurred in some cases
[*] Fixes for cases when the Raven couldn't have been found or sent
[*] Ferins are less likely to fall under the water
[*] Fixed - Ferins not being able to be healed in rare cases
[*] Ancient Eskoim Ports quest on 2nd island, Take the blue crystal objective has no longer Ragna's icon next to it
[*] Fixed - Snow Herb couldn’t have been picked up in one place on the map
[/list]
IF you’ve encountered any of those bugs, you can let us know how it works after the update!

[h2]Also we added animation and visual effects when using consumables:)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d2cd721250aa974fd7b0db71328ee7c4c7bc1e5f.gif[/img]

Now, we have some additional info…

[h2]First Dwarf on Tokyo Game Show 2024[/h2]

We’re flying to TOKYO! The event will take place September 26 (Thursday) – September 29 (Sunday), 2024 and [b]First Dwarf will be featured as one of the games for “Selected Indie 80”. [/b]
From there, we have a chance to become “Sense of Wonder Night 2024” finalists. Keep your fingers crossed and come to our booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/3ce4b02929bdd4f9a78a5fbb07c911a6808f0208.gif[/img]

You can read more about the “Selected Indie 80” [url=https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2024/en/program/indie/indie80/]here.[/url]

It’s a huge opportunity for us that will give us a lot of visibility. We’re truly honored to be one of the candidates. 

[h2]Your Dog in First Dwarf 🐶
[/h2]
Do you remember our cat contest? Many of you asked us: “But what if I don’t have a cat?” So now we bring justice for dogs and you can submit your furry friend in our special Discord channel called 🎉Challenges🎉, you won’t miss it thanks to these colorful party poppers.

Remember to vote for your favorite participant with our exclusive “goofy Ragna emoji” (seeing her is worth joining Discord alone).

[url=https://discord.gg/rr4nDK545C][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png[/img][/url]

[b]The dog with the most of that reaction will join our animal hall of fame and become a placeholder picture in our Technology Tree.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/061b150204b0e224bc8a78750adb9545df02a904.png[/img]
Thank you for your support as we continue to expand our project! Your help is absolutely irreplaceable and we are really happy with the direction the game is heading right now.

We wish you a great day and we’ll be back soon!
[i]Star Drifters Team 🌟🚀[/i]

notes.title: Update #6:⚓Ship fixes and MORE!
notes.content:
[b]Hi Everyone![/b]

Today, we are releasing a new patch with many fixes for the bugs that have been encountered after our recent update. Most of them were caused by loading the older saves and playing on the newest build. Thank you so much for your patience and understanding, some bugs are really hard to predict and they caught us by surprise, but thanks to your amazing help and all the saves you’ve sent us, we managed to solve the most important issues.

[h2]Full Change Log (Version 0.413):[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Now you can build while using the Airship[/b]
[*] [b]From now on newly uncovered map icons will be saved after loading[/b]
[*] [b]Reworked quest that now provides a better introduction to flying with the Airship and its associated mechanics, plus:[/b] [list]
[*] Anchor Spots and bundles are now available at the 1st technology level in Shipmakers guild
[*] Now you earn 2 technology points during this quest
[*] Bigger area for Ragna to return to the Airship
[*] While flying with Ragna outside of the Airship you can choose to return to it with the character circle menu
[/list] [*] [b]Fixed the issue with Airship not being able to fly up and down after loading an older save[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed the issue with missing stranger/Archseeker on the 3rd island and the quest with Eskoim Turrets[/b]
[*] Fixed the issue with talking to the Guild Chief on the 1st and 2nd island
[*] Fixed the issue with missing blueprints for Thread and Plant Fiber
[*] More Reed on 1st and 2nd island
[*] Fixed missing quests on the 3rd island
[*] Fixed Anchor Spot placement, it will better fit the grid
[*] Updated world map of the 3rd island
[*] Fixed issue with Tru going through the Iron Deposit model while gathering Iron
[*] New animations for the scared settlers
[/list]
[h2]Better introduction to the Airship[/h2]

Anchor Spots and bundles are now available at the 1st technology level in Shipmakers guild and [b]you can also build structures while in the Airship. [/b]We also added additional objectives that should guide you better through Airship related mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/037748c6ef0edcf2a9cae433f9b6f2926fdec1b8.gif[/img]

Now you can use the circle menu to go back to your Airship when you fly with Ragna after exiting it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/3c02b27cc58ecccbb30ca33263f7553e22b403a3.gif[/img]

[h2]Missing Quests and Archseeker[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/ae48dde844ac2f99d9b29fc01d0d7f88f19c202d.png[/img]

Some of you couldn’t find the stranger on the newest island, now the Archseeker is here and ready to talk with you all. As well as the missing quests are now ready to be taken care of. Good luck Adventurers!

[h2]Uncovered map icons now will be saved after loading[/h2]

Finally icons on the map won't disappear after reloading the saves. Those nests and tainted creatures won’t escape you now. When you discover them now, they will stay in place.

[b]Remember, if you load an older save, you need to discover them one last time 😉 and from that moment on, they will be saved.
[/b]
Thank you again for your help, it really means the world to us. We try to solve the problems you’re having as fast as we can and check our Steam Discussions, e-mails and Discord regularly to keep track of what we can make better. Also we love hearing your feedback on different aspects of the game and chatting with you.

[url=https://discord.gg/rr4nDK545C][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png[/img][/url]

We are getting back to work and we wish you a great gaming weekend!
[i]Star Drifters Team🌟🚀[/i]

notes.title: Update #5 BIG: Welcome to Ruptured Canyon!
notes.content:
[b]Hi Adventurers! 👋[/b]

If you read the title, you already know what’s up! [b]We are adding the 3rd island [/b]- more than double the game area compared to what was available during Early Access. But it's not just about quantity. [h3]That's why we've introduced new weapons, fearsome enemies, a brand-new clan, challenging puzzles, and much more.[/h3]

The size of this island gives us many opportunities for further development. We'll be working on adding new content and we will continue to polish this new area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/2d2e70965abd867ac9af0822fe6eba955da6ffa8.gif[/img]

We’re really excited about the direction the game is heading, and it’s all thanks to you — our amazing community. Your incredible support, invaluable feedback, and relentless bug-hunting have been crucial in shaping the game. We couldn’t have done it without you!

[h2]Full Change Log (Version 0.407):[/h2]

[h3][b]The BIGGEST changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW island (the biggest to date) including:
[*] NEW Scholars Guild
[*] NEW Technology to unlock
[*] NEW buildings 
[list]
[*] Scholars Research Center 
[*] Scholars Community Hut 
[*] Anchor Spot
[/list] [*]3 NEW variants of weapons to unlock in the Technology Tree
[*]Monster variants of animals improved and added into enemy waves and dungeons; 
[list]
[*]new coloration added for all enemies based on their type
[/list][*]First iteration of the Airship 
[list]
[*]you can enter and exit Airship in the Ports and buildable Anchor Spots
[*]Ship can’t fly into the tainted areas marked on the map as purple clouds
[/list][*]New consumable items (you can see the full list on our >>[url=https://discord.gg/rr4nDK545C]Discord![/url]<<
[*]UI rework 
[list]
[*]added equip tab for every character where you can assign weapons and consumables
[*]quick access slots for consumable items
[/list][*]New pickups in the game world
[/list][h3][b]Other Important changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]DLSS is now available for Nvidia (joining earlier available XeSS in the menu)
[*]Now you can set your own marker on the map
[*]Now you can knock on the settler’s house to make them come out
[/list]
[h2]Let’s go through it! 📝[/h2]

[h3]New Island = New Challenges[/h3]

It’s not just a new island… It is the biggest island from the three we currently have in our game. What does the mysterious fog hide?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b667d51dd38b8dc2a6209cc7e276dd8f17e51353.gif[/img]
You’ll find there new Scholars Guild and following it - new technology to unlock and new buildings, such as Research Center, Community Hut and Anchor Spots.

[h3]3 NEW weapons ⛏️[/h3]

The more the better, right? Now you have three NEW weapons to unlock in your Technology Tree, which are:
[list]
[*] Ancestor’s Pickaxe - 50% more efficient than normal pickaxe.
[*] Dwarven Hammer - classic dwarven hammer, gives higher chances to stagger enemies.
[*] Artifact Hammer - ancient hammer, tarnished and rusty, but still noble. Very powerful.
[/list]
[h3]Tainted animals added in enemy waves 🐺[/h3]

Fighting monsters can be tricky, we know. That's why… We are giving you ANOTHER challenge! You're welcome! Now, Monster versions of animals join the enemy waves and will attack your colonies. Be prepared!

[h3]Flying with the Airship ⚓[/h3]

What, did you think that only Ragna could fly? Dwarves are masters of engineering after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/2f27a20a8bcc8a0278ad14f0d5f790f3d3a20596.gif[/img]
The first iteration of Airship is here, you can now obtain it after finishing the quest "Colony for the Shipmakers" on the 2nd island. You can enter and exit Airship in the Ports and buildable Anchor Spots. Make sure to unlock the Anchor Spot in the Technology Tree first!

[b]But first you’ll need to clear the port of dark magic…[/b]

To transport resources between islands, we added Wood, Stone and Iron Bundles that you can craft. You can use them at any time to gain 100 pieces of the chosen resource. We will be expanding systems related to airship transportation. We’d love to hear what you think about this!

[h3]Consumable items 🫐[/h3]

Now you can use consumables, by accessing your inventory and pressing “use” with a correct key or button.
OR you can use new quick slots at the bottom of the screen where you will see the items you've assigned in the equipement tab in character menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/86d3e4f23ae9b58100573492cb7c72aba66803a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/2fe9477a6d3507b7d931794b27c33536a1a7665f.png[/img]
Every character has its own set of things that can be equipped. Some of the consumables can be used by multiple characters.

[b]Thank you all so much for all your amazing feedback and ideas. Your input in First Dwarf is absolutely irreplaceable. 🙇[/b]

[h3]Stay tuned for even more exciting updates[/h3]
Here is a little work in progress, first concept art of the mysterious creature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/02bfc027ccf4d80d51abd0d48a8f739a8d9bc9e9.png[/img]

[h2]Airship Guide[/h2]

If you're having any troubles with this new feature and progressing to the 3rd island, we prepared a guide that might be helpful for you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3315999501]here[/url].

One last thing!

[h3]🐈 Cat Contest results 🐈[/h3]

Some time ago our voting on Discord ended. Thank you for all the cat pics you’ve sent us, the kitty with the most reactions was Nomik 😋 Big congratulations! 🏆 However, we decided that we want to add more than just ONE new cute cat to our game, so we took MiMi who got 2nd place! 🥈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/9eeb9e51056b231c3aeeaecbd745333f80733c25.png[/img]
We added them to our game as a placeholder for upcoming unlockable content in Technology Tree. Who knows, maybe we will hold the contest once more in the future?

Have a great day!
[i]Star Drifters Team🌟🚀[/i]

notes.content:
Hey Adventurers! We’re back with a new update!

[h2]Full Change Log (Version 0.311):[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Recovering Resources when destroying a building[/b]
[*] [b]Improvements to clarity of Rising Tech in Research Center[/b]
[*] [b]FPS limit added in game options[/b]
[*] Co-op Fixes for Research Center - sometimes client saw wrong status of Research Center
[*] New versions of Settlers, more will come:)
[*] Fixed Items in the lake near first island that couldn’t be picked
[*] Fixes with switching character bugs
[*] We toned down effects that were not pleasant for the eyes
[*] Fixes in co-op, now client will deal proper amount of damage
[*] Fixes in co-op, foxes when hit will turn into monsters 
[*] Fix with locking player animation when you open the character menu
[*] Smaller fixes and optimisation tweaks
[/list]

[h2]Recovering resources[/h2]

Now while removing a building you’ll get your resources back. The amount of material you’ll retrieve will depend on the health bar of the building you’re getting rid of.

If your building has 100-90% health you’ll get a full resource refund.
If a building has below 90% health, resources will be refunded proportionally to the amount of health left (the lowest resource refund being 20%)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0ef87927b619200ede2194c515af4852294fb186.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements to clarity of Rising Tech in Research Center[/h2]

Now in the Research Description you will see a new text with colored statuses at the top. Another thing that we added is the addition of an in game button for Rising Technology. We also improved color coding and some co-op related bugs in this system.

We hope that this mechanic will be clearer for you:)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0ac52175856a30ae4e1b541131940ac7edca31b7.png[/img]

[h2]FPS limit added in game options[/h2]

FPS limit can also be set separately for the game and in-game menu, just in case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c8fa1a3b71f1e2b5bf4996424862a83fdfc8e00e.gif[/img]

Have a nice weekend!
[i]Oliwia & Damian from Star Drifters [/i]🌟🚀

notes.title: Update #2: Co-op update
notes.content:
[b]Hi Adventurers![/b]

Are you ready for the weekend? Now, with our new update of First Dwarf[b] YOU WILL BE![/b] We didn’t want you to wait until next week. 🛠️

New hotfix just landed, and it's mainly focused on fixing co-op bugs. It mattered to us to improve the multiplayer experience before the weekend starts for all the people who want to play First Dwarf with their friend.

[h1]Full Change Log (Version 0.306):[/h1]
[list]

[h2]Marker on the map[/h2]

We fixed the bug where the markers on the map didn’t show themselves.When the quest is far away there is an indicator that acts as a compass. Now it should be clear where you’re heading to:) 

[h2]Next Update Soon![/h2]

We’re not slowing down and working on the next update.

Stay tuned, follow our social media to not miss a thing AND, of course, join our Discord server if you wish to discuss the game with us.

notes.title: Early Access Update #1
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]🎤🧔

After a bumpy start of Early Access we regrouped and prepared for you first of many Updates for the First Dwarf. First, we want to fix as many issues that you encounter in the game and after that, alongside fixes, we will be adding new content. We know that there is much to be done but we will get there!

Thank you all for the feedback you’re giving us, we’re trying our best to keep up with all the messages. 

[h2]Full Change Log (Version 0.302):[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Autosave added[/b]
[*] [b]Added option for Tru and Ragna to build structures![/b]
[*] [b]Added return to safe point option in radial menu[/b]
[*] We tried to fix falling through ground, it should now be rarer
[*] Changed recipes for Workshop and Alchemy Station addons 
[*] Fix - unlocking technology can be done now anywhere (you still need to build and level up Research Center)
[*] Better and more optimized enemy and settlers pathfinding
[*] Fix with finishing Tainted Lake quest (still working on coop fixes)
[*] Added more thread on the islands
[*] Added option to delete saves
[*] Added continue game button in the menu 
[*] Tweaks in enemy waves balance - if your base is big, waves should be more fair and enemies won't target Mana Wells as often
[*] Fix with build Alchemy Station quest not finishing
[*] [b]FIX[/b] with some quests and items description missing!
[*] Tweaks with building walls, lots of places are updated so you can place fences more conveniently
[/list]
[h2]Added return to safe point option in radial menu[/h2]
This option should help with all of you that have this nasty bug with falling under the ground. We also made some improvements that should make falling under ground more rare. For the next update we hope to fully fix that issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/bc24e7e16bdfb976809bc80f7dd56156d477c21d.gif[/img]
[h2]Autosave and continue game[/h2]
The game now saves itself automatically every 5 minutes and there are 24 slots for them, after that the older ones get replaced. The game will also save itself after exiting to the menu. We also added a save Delete button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/f4a0a78bb6f4dd6a248c68f9b50f6009232b53c4.png[/img]
Also, now you can choose “continue game” from the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/4987f5c373209428478ff5e9fb110a5be7dcbbe7.png[/img]
[h2]Ragna and Tru can build now[/h2]
[b]Now everyone can build. This should lead to some interesting scenarios:)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/40efa4d933ea673bd94e423786c9f520b4014e0c.gif[/img]

In the next update we’re planning to further expand this by giving Ragna option to remove buildings too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/1d454bab0086951b09310979e43241b4d13397b8.gif[/img]
[h2]Building[/h2]
We are working on a better building, now you will have the option to build near cliffs. Also we fixed some places where building was blocked, now building fences should be more enjoyable. Lots of features and fixes regarding building will come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/dd7044273e1965f88231d941f662d9d4409efb38.gif[/img]
[h2]Tainted Lake Bug fixed[/h2]
We’ve been made aware of a bug that didn’t allow us to finish the Tainted Lake quest. That was fixed, thanks to all the people that sent us their save files! Thank you all so much, it was a big help in tracking down what went wrong there.

[h2]Next Update Soon![/h2]
We’re working on the next update that will fix another batch of important problems! 

[url=https://discord.gg/rr4nDK545C][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png[/img][/url]
If you want to chat with us about the game, bugs and other stuff join our discord.

[b]Soon we will be back with more news and updates! [/b]
[i]Oliwia & Damian from Star Drifters [/i]🌟🚀
Over and out

notes.title: Play the DEMO on June 8th!
notes.content:
Hi, Dwarves! 🧔‍♂️

Are you ready to play the First Dwarf DEMO on June 8th? We just can’t wait to share our work with you. Everyone will finally be able to become the 🛠 [b]FIRST DWARF[/b] 🛠 and build your own colony!

[b][h3]Watch our new Demo Release Date Teaser! 🎥[/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=1vFkAe3B9rU;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vFkAe3B9rU[/previewyoutube]
Hopefully you’re just excited as we are! We prepared for this day for quite a long time, because we wanted to make sure that we’ll give you the demo that you’ll love to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/89b3d1f3c2c8fff160bc7236069d027e61a5a25c.gif[/img]

Download our completely 🎉 [b]FREE DEMO[/b] 🎉from First Dwarf’s Steam page on June 8th and let the fun begin!

[h3]What’s in the DEMO[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712830/First_Dwarf/

In First Dwarf Demo you take on the role of Dwarf Tru and go fulfill the mission given to you by your Clan of the Northern Dwarves. Find the new and safe home for the settlers, after making sure that the uncharted lands of Driftland are ready to inhabit.

On this amazing journey you’re accompanied by a sassy Dragon, Ragna. She can help you with her fire breath and ability to fly to the various places that are out of Mech’s and Tru’s reach. Change freely through characters and use their different skills!

Fight dangerous monsters and build the greatest colony that will endure the attacks of your enemies! Build defensive walls and turrets that will help you destroy your opponents. 💥

It’s an introduction to our game, where you’ll get to know our dear characters, learn the main mechanics, like building, combat and crafting and have a great time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/6d6d43a132e3acfc971ef09096e0da9d80329fd0.gif[/img]

[h3]Single and co-op mode 🙋🙋[/h3]

You can play our Demo with a friend! Free Demo version supports local multiplayer with splitscreen as well as online multiplayer through Steam. Please keep in mind that we’re still working on it!

[h3]💌Message for our Community Playtesters💌[/h3]

Below is a summary[b] Changelog[/b] of things that have changed since our 1st and 2nd Playtests. 
[b]We want to emphasize that lots of these changes and fixes were made thanks to your feedback!![/b]
Thank you all SO MUCH!

New:
[list]
[*] New voice overs for Tru & Ragna
[*] New economy system

[olist]
[*] Maintenance costs added for the buildings
[*] Better communication of unpowered buildings (we hope :) )
[*] Updated UI to show resource production and shortage
[*] When you don't have enough resources, building furthest from the mana well will become unpowered, watch out for that :o
[/olist]
[*] New building added: Research Center - in full game this is the place where you will be rising technology level of specific guild and also be able to unlock new blueprints.
[*] New animations for the settlers
[*] Side quest “Eskoim Secret Weapon”
[*] Better dash/dodge system
[/list]
Quality of life improvements:
[list]
[*] Camera shake slider - some of you felt discomfort when camera shakes were present, so we made sure that now everyone can enjoy the game with our option of turning them off or minimizing them!
[*] Doubled speed of repairing and mana extraction
[*] Added popup tutorials for:

[olist]
[*] High Jump
[*] Rising Settlement
[*] Switching Characters
[*] Assigning Skills
[/olist]
[*] Buttons for building/destroying separated (it’s important to us to finish key binding options for the Early access)
[*] Mech high jump and glide improved
[*] Progress of the development tree
[*] Improved clarity of workshop quest
[*] Option to turn on/off Defensive Towers reach radius
[*] New loading screen
[*] Map scrolls faster
[*] Adjusted audio in intro cutscene
[*] Fixes for online and local co-op
[*] Tru’s animation updated
[*] Fixed blocking of character actions in split screen
[*] and many more other bigger and smaller fixes:)!
[/list]
[h3]New voices of Tru and Ragna ❓❗[/h3]

YES! Hold on tight, because that's a BIG NEWS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/891355161cf3a6684ea540abdb5e2ef80d8fc17f.gif[/img]

For the first time you can hear the brand new voices of our main characters! We heard your opinions and made that change one of our main priorities for the demo release.

Soon we’ll give you more info about our voice actors. We’re very curious about your thoughts after hearing them!

[h3]JUNE 8TH is a date to remember![/h3]

To celebrate our Demo release and also due to the start of Future Games Show [b](also June 8th, where we’ll reveal our Early Access release date)[/b], our team members, Anastasiia and Oliwia, will be playing the First Dwarf Demo live on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/f3130229fee40e96a49a6f53a85f1cd5762a679d.png[/img]

Please join us or we’ll be SAD! >:(( - Anastasiia and Oliwia

[h3]How to support us? Join our Discord! ✨[/h3]

We’re eagerly waiting for your feedback after you throw yourself into our fantasy world of Driftland! Tell us EVERYTHING you want about your experiences with our game on First Dwarf’s Discord server!

We’re waiting for you! 🤩

[url=https://discord.gg/rr4nDK545C][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png[/img]
[/url]
[b]Join the adventure on JUNE 8TH![/b]

[i]Take care! [/i]
Star Drifters Team 🌟🚀
